a: No, the effect reads “you may,” so you can choose whether or not to trash the card.
If you don't trash a card, you don’t get to return a Digimon card with [Seven Great Demon Lords] or [Three Musketeers] in its type from your trash to your hand.
Card Q&A.q: When I play this card, do I have to trash 1 card in my hand?

Effect: [On Play] You may trash 1 card in your hand. If you do, return 1 Digimon card with [Seven Great Demon Lords] or [Three Musketeers] in its type from your trash to your hand.
